description: Oh My Pi - AI-powered coding assistant in the terminal.

next.name: acp
tip: Run Oh My Pi as an ACP (Agent Client Protocol) server over stdio.

option.name: --from-local
tip: Migrate source: local SQLite + env vars (required for migrate).

option.name: --include-disabled
tip: Import credentials whose JSON has disabled: true.

option.name: --include-env
tip: Capture env-var API keys for providers not yet on broker.

option.name: --include-oauth
tip: Also upload OAuth from local SQLite during migrate.

next.name: migrate
tip: Migrate credentials from local store to broker.

next.name: serve
tip: Boot the broker against the local SQLite store.

next.name: auth-gateway
tip: Run an auth-gateway forward proxy backed by the configured broker.

option.name: --strict
tip: Additionally probe each credential against its provider endpoint.

next.name: check
tip: Probe each broker credential to see which one is producing 401s.

next.name: serve
tip: Boot the gateway against the configured broker.

next.name: status
tip: Show local gateway + broker config status.

next.name: bench
tip: Benchmark models with the same prompt: time-to-first-token and generation throughput.

option.name: --max-tokens
tip: Max output tokens per request (default: 512; cache mode: 64).

option.name: --par
tip: Execute runs with N parallel queries (default: 4).

option.name: --runs
tip: Requests per model (results are averaged; default: 10).

option.name: --service-tier
tip: Service tier applied per model family.

next.name: browser-relay
tip: Run the local CDP relay that lets the browser tool drive your own Chrome tabs.

option.name: --no-group
tip: Don't gather controllable tabs into an omp tab group.

option.name: --token
tip: Require the extension to present this token.

option.name: --verbose
tip: Log relay traffic summaries to stderr.

next.name: install
tip: Write the Chrome extension to disk.

next.name: serve
tip: Serve the relay on the default port.

next.name: cleanse
tip: Detect and fix project diagnostics with weighted parallel subagents.

option.name: --tests
tip: Also run configured project test suites.

next.name: commit
tip: Generate a commit message and update changelogs.

next.name: completions
tip: Print a shell completion script (bash, zsh, or fish).

next.name: dry-balance
tip: Dry-run OAuth account balancing across random session ids.

option.name: --bench
tip: Send one live benchmark request per OAuth account.

option.name: --count
tip: Number of random session ids to try.

option.name: --model
tip: Model selector (same syntax as --model on omp).

next.name: gallery
tip: Preview tool renderers across streaming, in-progress, success, and failure states.

option.name: --expanded
tip: Render the expanded variant of each renderer.

option.name: --plain
tip: Strip ANSI styling from the output.

option.name: --screenshot
tip: Capture the rendered output as PNG screenshot(s) via VHS.

option.name: --state
tip: Render only the given lifecycle state(s).

option.name: --tool
tip: Render a single tool by name.

option.name: --retain-newest-global
tip: Always keep this many newest sessions active.

option.name: --retain-newest-per-cwd
tip: Always keep this many newest sessions per cwd active.

next.name: grievances
tip: View, clean, or push reported tool issues (auto-QA grievances).

option.name: --id
tip: Delete a single grievance by id.

option.name: --limit
tip: Number of recent issues to show.

next.name: install
tip: Install or link an extension package (alias of plugin install/link).

next.name: join
tip: Join a shared collab session (same as /join).

next.name: models
tip: List, search, and refresh available models.

option.name: --extension
tip: Load an extension file before listing.

next.name: ls
tip: List every available model, grouped by provider.

next.name: read
tip: Show what the read tool will return for a path, URL, or internal URI.

next.name: say
tip: Synthesize text with the local TTS engine and play it through the speakers.

option.name: --file
tip: Read the text to speak from this file.

option.name: --out
tip: Write WAV to this path instead of playing.

next.name: setup
tip: Run onboarding setup or install dependencies for optional features.

option.name: --no-snapshot
tip: Skip sourcing snapshot from user shell.

next.name: tiny-models
tip: Download tiny local models (session titles + memory).

next.name: token
tip: Get the API key or OAuth token for a provider.

option.name: --force-refresh
tip: Force refresh the OAuth token even if it has not expired.

option.name: --list
tip: List the provider's OAuth accounts and exit.

option.name: --raw
tip: Output the raw credential value without parsing.

next.name: ttsr
tip: Inspect and test Time-Traveling Stream Rules (TTSR).

option.name: --file
tip: Snippet file path, or - for stdin.

option.name: --max-bytes
tip: Maximum file size to scan in bytes; 0 disables the limit.

option.name: --path
tip: Candidate file path for scope/glob matching.

option.name: --rule
tip: Rule markdown file to test in isolation.

option.name: --source
tip: Match source: text, thinking, or tool.

option.name: --tool
tip: Tool name when source is tool.

option.name: --verbose
tip: Show every evaluated rule, not just triggered ones.

next.name: scan
tip: Scan a directory for TTSR rule violations.

next.name: test
tip: Test a snippet against TTSR rules.

next.name: usage
tip: Show provider usage limits for every authenticated account.

option.name: --history
tip: Show recorded usage-limit history instead of a live snapshot.

option.name: --provider
tip: Only show usage for this provider id.

option.name: --redact
tip: Redact account emails/ids for sharing screenshots.

next.name: worktree
tip: List or clear agent-managed git worktrees.

option.name: --all
tip: Clear every entry, including live PR-checkout worktrees.

option.name: --dry-run
tip: Print what would be removed without touching the filesystem.

option.name: --add-dir
tip: Add a workspace directory beyond the working directory.

option.name: --advisor
tip: Enable the advisor runtime (passively reviews each turn and injects notes).

option.name: --alias
tip: Create a shell shortcut for the selected profile and exit.

option.name: --allow-home
tip: Allow starting in ~ without auto-switching to a temp dir.

option.name: --append-system-prompt
tip: Append text or file contents to the system prompt.

option.name: --auto-approve
tip: Auto-approve all tool calls (skip approval prompts).

option.name: --config
tip: Load an extra config.yml-style overlay for this run.

option.name: --cwd
tip: Directory to start in (overrides the launch cwd).

option.name: --export
tip: Export session file to HTML and exit.

option.name: --extension
tip: Load an extension file (can be used multiple times).

option.name: --from-claude
tip: Import a Claude Code session into OMP.

option.name: --from-codex
tip: Import a Codex session into OMP.

option.name: --hide-thinking
tip: Hide thinking blocks in TUI output.

option.name: --hook
tip: Load a hook/extension file (can be used multiple times).

option.name: --max-time
tip: Stop the session after this duration (e.g. 600, 10m, 1h).

option.name: --mode
tip: Output mode: text (default), json, rpc, or rpc-ui.

option.name: --model
tip: Model to use (fuzzy match: opus, gpt-5.2, or openai/gpt-5.2).

option.name: --models
tip: Comma-separated model patterns for Ctrl+P cycling.

option.name: --no-extensions
tip: Disable extension discovery (explicit -e paths still work).

option.name: --no-lsp
tip: Disable LSP tools, formatting, and diagnostics.

option.name: --no-prewalk
tip: Disable prewalk even if prewalk.enabled is set.

option.name: --plan-yolo
tip: Force read-only plan mode at start, auto-approve the plan, then switch to --plan-yolo-into to implement it.

option.name: --plan-yolo-into
tip: Target model for plan-yolo execution (default the smol role).

option.name: --prewalk
tip: Switch from the active model to a fast/cheap model at the first edit/write after the plan's todo list exists.

option.name: --prewalk-into
tip: Target model for prewalk (default the smol role).

option.name: --print
tip: Non-interactive mode: process prompt and exit.

option.name: --print-thoughts
tip: Include thinking blocks in print mode text output.

option.name: --profile
tip: Use an isolated profile for auth, sessions, settings, and caches.

option.name: --resume
tip: Resume a session (by ID prefix, path, or picker if omitted).

option.name: --service-tier
tip: OpenAI service tier for this session.

option.name: --session-dir
tip: Directory for session storage and lookup.

option.name: --skills
tip: Comma-separated glob patterns to filter skills.

option.name: --thinking
tip: Set thinking level: off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max, auto.

option.name: --tools
tip: Comma-separated list of tools to enable (default: all).

option.name: --version
tip: Print the version number and exit.
